summary: We are seeking a C++ Software Engineer to join our team focused on developing and maintaining desktop software extensions for the customer's platform.
responsibilities: Design, develop and maintain extensions for the customer's platform
Collaborate with a distributed team to deliver software solutions
Apply Object-Oriented Programming principles in software development
Contribute to code quality through unit and integration testing
Participate in agile software development processes
Learn and apply new languages and technologies as needed
Support DevOps practices using platforms like Azure DevOps
required_skills: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field preferred
Strong knowledge of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and modern design patterns
Experience with C++ desktop development on Windows 10
English proficiency at B2 Upper-Intermediate level
nice_to_have_skills: Knowledge of Python or willingness to learn
Experience with Azure DevOps or similar DevOps platforms
Understanding of unit and integration testing
